subparts.method: Match the coefficients of the original a*sin(t)+b*cos(t) to the specified target. Independently derive positive R by the coefficient norm and phase by a quadrant-aware atan2. Keep exact internal parameters; round only the requested/displayed phase. Verify both coefficient equations, rather than treating a rounded phase as an exact identity.
subparts.phase_comparison_basis: Exact phase unless a decimal display is explicitly compared; the unrounded candidate is retained separately for graph/solution checks.

printed_precision_requirement.reason: The question explicitly asks2decimalplaces; the printed answer gives only1. The unrounded phase remains independently derived.

subparts.method: Factor or transform the original equation without dividing away a possibly zero factor. Solve every admissible branch in the original interval, reject out-of-range ratios and original poles, and substitute each candidate into the original equation. All exact roots precede any comparison with printed rounded values.
